scope.description: Implicit joint exit with the current leader retained as a voter, a transient failed transfer, no ongoing failures and fair servicing of all implementation-requested work.
assumptions: Configuration entry is genuinely committed and applied through the normal interface.
Transport may lose finitely many messages, then delivers all generated messages; local Ready work is processed reliably in order.
Stable available leader and sufficient incoming/outgoing voters; no infinite elections or failed storage.
No obligation for a fresh unrelated user command or manually proposed explicit exit is imposed on implicit-transition callers.
excluded: No claim that configuration proposals must be admitted initially.
No crash/restart, Byzantine behavior, explicit joint transitions or arbitrary membership changes.
No claim of consensus safety failure or measured downstream availability outage.
